title: Turkey Cutlets with Lemon Lentils and Cottage Cheese
blurb: Pan-fried turkey with soft coral lentils, leeks and a simple lemon cottage cheese sauce.
steps: Rinse the lentils in cold water, then put them in a pan with 500ml water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until soft and the water is absorbed.
Meanwhile, trim and slice the leek into thin rounds, then rinse well to remove any grit. Peel and finely chop the garlic.
Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the leek and garlic for 5 minutes until soft.
Season the turkey cutlets with salt and pepper. Heat the remaining oil in another frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the turkey for 4 to 5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Zest and juice the lemon. Mix the cottage cheese with the lemon zest, half the lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Stir the cooked leeks through the lentils with the remaining lemon juice. Serve the lentils topped with the turkey cutlets and cottage cheese sauce.
